subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Dr. Neema Msangi is a marine biology researcher.
• One of her experiments involves studying fish navigation using a dual-tank system.
• The system connects two separate aquarium tanks.
• The tanks are positioned at different water temperatures.
• The tanks share a single connecting tube that allows fish to move between them.
prompt: The student wants to describe how the tanks in the dual-tank system are connected. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: To study fish navigation, Dr. Neema Msangi created a dual-tank system that connects two separate aquarium tanks.
choices.B: The two aquarium tanks in the dual-tank system are connected by sharing a single connecting tube that allows fish to move between them while maintaining different water temperatures.
choices.C: There are two separate aquarium tanks positioned at different water temperatures in the dual-tank system.
choices.D: The dual-tank system is an experiment created by marine biology researcher Dr. Neema Msangi.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence correctly describes how the tanks in the system are connected: they share a single connecting tube that allows fish to move between them while maintaining different water temperatures.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence describes features of the tanks without indicating that they are connected or describing how they are connected.
